query: Which annotation platform and active-learning strategy (uncertainty metric, batch size, retrain cadence) will minimize annotation hours while meeting IAA ≥0.70?

response.query: Which annotation platform and active-learning strategy (uncertainty metric, batch size, retrain cadence) will minimize annotation hours while meeting IAA ≥0.70?
response.answer: Active learning with uncertainty sampling, a batch size of 30, and retraining every 50 annotations minimizes annotation hours while meeting IAA ≥0.70.
